title: 12 Best Melbourne Night Markets
description: Discover Melbourne's vibrant night markets, from the iconic Queen Victoria Market to hidden foodie gems. Explore street food, unique crafts, and live entertainment. Your guide to the best evening experiences in Melbourne.

places.name: Queen Victoria Market Summer Night Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Jam-packed Korean BBQ skewers and a fresh churro with dulce de leche.

places.name: Queen Victoria Market Winter Night Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A piping hot bowl of German goulash or French onion soup, followed by a warm apple strudel.

places.name: Grazeland
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try the authentic Thai street food or a loaded smash burger, washed down with a local craft beer.

places.name: Welcome to Thornbury
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Whatever local food truck takes your fancy – the menu changes daily, but burgers and tacos are reliable hits.

places.name: South Melbourne Market Twilight Markets
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try fresh oysters or paella from a market stall, and browse for unique local gifts.

places.name: Prahran Market Seasonal Evening Events
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Sample artisanal cheeses and charcuterie, paired with Victorian wines, or indulge in gourmet sliders.

places.name: Dandenong Market Global Street Food Night Markets
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Seek out the Ethiopian stews with injera bread or some freshly made Malaysian satay skewers.

places.name: The District Docklands Night Markets
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for unique fusion tacos or classic gelato, enjoying the evening views of the Melbourne Star.

places.name: Fed Square Seasonal Food Events
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore the diverse offerings; you might find anything from craft beer tastings to regional Australian specialties.

places.name: Preston Market Evening Food Festivals
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try some freshly grilled souvlaki or Vietnamese banh mi prepared with market-fresh ingredients.

places.name: Box Hill Lunar New Year Festival (Night Market Component)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Steamed dumplings, crispy spring rolls, and freshly made bubble tea.

places.name: Bunjil Place Night Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Check out the rotating food trucks for gourmet hot dogs or specialty pizzas, and browse local craft stalls.
